title: Plant and Fungal DNA Extraction Using a QIAGEN QIAxtractor
author: Laura L Forrest
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bc2fiybn
materials: Separate each row of strips by at least one empty row before removing lids to mimimize the possibility of contamination. Carefully remove the lids from the strips, avoiding transferring any loose powder between tubes or contaminating gloves. Using a multichannel pipette, add 400 μl of the lysis mix to the centrifuged homogenized tissue samples in the 1.2 ml QIAGEN collection microtubes, shake the tubes to collect any powder from the lids and sides, then incubate for 1 hr to 1 ½ hrs in an Eppendorf ThermoMixer, increasing from room temperature to 70° C, with 700-800 rpm shaking.
Using a multichannel pipette, transfer 220 μl of each sample from the plate of 1.2 ml QIAGEN collection microtubes into a 96-well Lysis Plate, avoiding disturbing the pellets.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Pre-treatment Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a lysis mix per sample or as a master mix for a 96-sample plate.

substeps.instruction: Mix 4 μl DX enzyme (kept at 4° C) and 416 μl Tissue Digest (DXT) per sample.
For a 96-sample master mix, combine 40.4 ml DXT and 392 μl DX enzyme.
If extracting from fresh tissue (instead of silica-dried or herbarium samples), substitute 4 μl DXT with 4 μl RNase A.

steps.title: Pellet Sample Debris
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenized tissue samples in plates of 1.2 ml QIAGEN collection microtubes to remove loose tissue powder from near the tube lids.

substeps.instruction: Spin at maximum speed for approximately 10 min.
If using a single plate, balance the centrifuge by splitting the strips of microtubes across two racks (alternating strips and empty rows).

steps.title: Configure QIAxtractor and Load Reagents
steps.instruction: Load the Lysis plate into the QIAxtractor and add the required reagents per 96-sample plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 66 ml DX Binding (DXB, kept at 4° C).
Add 122 ml DX Wash (DXW).
Add 62 ml DX Final Wash (DXF).
Add 12.4 ml Elution buffer (E).

steps.title: Execute Automated Extraction Process
steps.instruction: Run the programmed QIAxtractor sequence for DNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Robotically add 440 μl DXB to each 220 μl sample in the Lysis Plate and incubate for 5 min.
Transfer 600 μl of the mixture into the vacuum plate and apply vacuum for 5 min to dry the membrane.
Perform wash 1: add 200 μl DXB followed by a 5 min vacuum.
Perform wash 2: add 600 μl DXW followed by a 1 min vacuum.
Perform wash 3: add 600 μl DXW followed by a 1 min vacuum.
Perform wash 4: add 600 μl DXF followed by a 1 min vacuum, followed by a final 5 min vacuum.
Transfer the vacuum plate above an elution plate, add 100 μl DXE, incubate for 5 min, and apply a 1 min vacuum to elute DNA.

steps.title: Store Extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the extracted DNA from the elution plate into new labelled plates or tubes.

substeps.instruction: Store the DNA at -20° C or 4° C.

steps.title: Clean Tungsten Beads for Reuse
steps.instruction: Remove and clean the tungsten beads used for homogenization.

substeps.instruction: Flush beads with running water.
Sonicate in Ultraware ultrasonic bath for approximately 2 mins.
Incubate in 0.4 M Hydrochloric acid for 1 min.
Flush again with running water to remove acid and air dry.
